caption: The drawing depicts a circular illustration placed roughly in the center of a cream-colored page. Within the circular frame, there are four human figures: one adult figure embraces or guides a child while another adult stands in front, gesturing with an outstretched arm, and a third adult stands in the background near a set of stairs leading to a structure. The scene includes architectural elements such as a staircase and two buildings or towers, with one building having a domed roof and the other rectangular windows. The figures are rendered in shades of brownish-red ink, with details in their clothing and facial features. There are small decorative motifs in each corner of the square that frames the circular image. Beneath the circular scene, the text "GEN. 21. 14." is written, referencing a biblical passage. The rest of the page is largely empty, except for a few smudges and marks near the top and bottom margins.
title: Fireplace Tile
